prompt: Create an original 120 second instrumental dub instrumental composition for coding, deep work and analytical tasks. Mood: focused, steady, precise. Instruments: round electric bass, organ, rimshot, echo guitar. Style: spacious offbeat chords with restrained tape delay. Tempo approximately 76 BPM; A minor. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep a stable repeating texture with very few distracting fills. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:40] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:40-01:20] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:20-02:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:00.

description.en: An electronic track featuring a steady drum beat, synth bass, and multiple synth layers creating a melodic and groovy atmosphere. The track has a relaxed yet engaging feel.
